notes:
## Better
- Pressing play on an E-Sys that was opened from its own shortcut now says it runs without E-Sys MAX, instead of only bringing it to the front.
- Remove from E-Sys works when E-Sys lists E-Sys MAX twice.
- The coding window no longer leaves a hidden process behind when it cannot open.
- A hand-edited settings file with empty parts no longer stops E-Sys from starting.
- The E-Sys settings window no longer shows an error when antivirus holds its change log.
- A clearer hint when an E-Sys folder needs administrator rights.
- Folder choices in the coding window are saved safely beside other launcher windows.
